# Groups - Test Cases (BF2: Group, members & invitations)

**Release under test:** Alumnye v1.4 (includes v1.3 invitation work). **Criticality: CRITICAL** - groups gate every event, poll, RSVP and payment.
**Sources:** FSD Anchor 4.1-4.2, Walkthrough v1.3 sections 8.1-8.7, Release 1.3 (invitations), FRD FR-UM-02/07/10-12.
**Platforms:** Android + iOS. **Test data:** yopmail invitees, generated group names, CSV files generated by the runner. OTP is typed by the tester only when a sign-in is needed (AUTH-004 registers the Anchor first).
**Out of scope for this module:** accepting an invite on a second device/user, invite-link app/web routing, multi-anchor promotion, import from another group - these need two users and belong to the end-to-end journey layer. Add Contacts is not exercised (needs device contacts + SMS; mobile out of scope).

> **Draft notice:** steps come from the requirement docs only. The group screens have not been seen on a device yet; locators in `locator-maps/Group-Elements.md` are docs-draft and will be healed / resolved by the AI on first runs.

### TC-GRP-001 - Anchor creates a group and lands on its Group Details
- Priority: High
- Type: Positive
- Preconditions: Signed in (Auth succeeded first); Anchor Home visible. The same user can own many groups, so this ALWAYS creates a new group.
- Test Data: name `QA Group <timestamp>`, description (valid text)
- Steps:
  1. Tap "+ New Group".
  2. Enter the group name and a description.
  3. Tap Create Group; acknowledge the "Group created successfully!" pop-up (OK).
- Expected Result: The group is created; Group Details opens showing the group name; the group appears on Anchor Home (with 'Since <date>').
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_001_create_group.py
- Notes: FR-UM-02: the creator becomes the group's Anchor. Walkthrough 8.2. The created group is saved to data/test_groups.json for later scenarios.

### TC-GRP-002 - Anchor Home offers + New Group and shows the right state
- Priority: High
- Type: Positive
- Preconditions: Signed in; Anchor view selected.
- Steps:
  1. Switch the MEMBER / ANCHOR toggle to ANCHOR.
  2. Look at the Anchor Home.
- Expected Result: "+ New Group" is shown. A user with no groups sees the welcome message ("Welcome to Alumnye! You don't have any groups yet..."); a user with groups sees the group list with 'Since <date>' cards.
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_002_anchor_home_state.py
- Notes: Walkthrough 8.1. Adaptive: never BLOCKED - it checks whichever state applies.

### TC-GRP-003 - Group Details shows About, member count and the Add Event button
- Priority: Medium
- Type: Positive
- Preconditions: A group created by GRP-001 exists.
- Test Data: last created test group
- Steps:
  1. Open the group from Anchor Home.
  2. Check the header card and actions.
- Expected Result: Group name; an About text (long text truncated to 2 lines with See More / Hide View); a clickable member count; an "Add Event" button (renamed from "New Event"); an add-member entry.
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_003_group_details_content.py
- Notes: Walkthrough 8.3. v1.4 category tiles are part of the Events module, not checked here.

### TC-GRP-004 - Add Members offers the invitation methods (Invite, Upload, Add Members, Add Contacts)
- Priority: High
- Type: Positive
- Preconditions: Group Details open.
- Test Data: none
- Steps:
  1. Open the add-member entry.
  2. Read the available tabs / options.
- Expected Result: Invite and Upload are present; Add Members and Add Contacts are present per v1.3. Every missing option is reported (soft checks).
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_004_add_members_options.py
- Notes: Docs differ: Walkthrough 8.4 lists Invite / Upload tabs only; Release 1.3 adds Add Members and Add Contacts. The scenario reports which exist. Add Contacts is not exercised further (needs device contacts + SMS; mobile is out of scope).

### TC-GRP-005 - Anchor invites a member by email and gets a success confirmation
- Priority: High
- Type: Positive
- Preconditions: Group Details open.
- Test Data: `<first>.<last>.<ts>@yopmail.com`
- Steps:
  1. Open add member -> Invite tab.
  2. Enter the yopmail address.
  3. Tap send.
- Expected Result: A success confirmation (v1.3 wording: "The invitation was sent successfully") is shown; the invitation appears as pending and the group's invite count increases.
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_005_invite_member_by_email.py
- Notes: Message wording is logged to message-catalog.md for review. The email arrives in the yopmail inbox (accepting the invite belongs to the end-to-end journey, not this module).

### TC-GRP-006 - Invite rejects an invalid email format
- Priority: High
- Type: Negative
- Preconditions: Invite tab open.
- Test Data: `abc@`, `plainaddress`, `no spaces@yopmail.com`
- Steps:
  1. Type each invalid value.
  2. Try to send.
- Expected Result: Nothing is sent; the user stays on Invite; the send button stays disabled or an error is shown (logged).
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_006_invite_invalid_email.py
- Notes: Walkthrough 8.4 / 8.6: format + space validation.

### TC-GRP-007 - Anchor cannot invite their own email address
- Priority: High
- Type: Negative
- Preconditions: Invite tab open; the Anchor's own email known (last registered test user).
- Test Data: the Anchor's own email
- Steps:
  1. Enter the Anchor's own email.
  2. Try to send.
- Expected Result: The invitation is blocked with a message (logged); no pending invitation is created.
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_007_invite_self_blocked.py
- Notes: Walkthrough 8.4: self-invite blocked (frontend and backend).

### TC-GRP-008 - Inviting the same email twice is blocked
- Priority: Medium
- Type: Negative
- Preconditions: An invitation to a yopmail address was already sent (the scenario sends it first).
- Test Data: same yopmail address twice
- Steps:
  1. Invite a new yopmail address successfully.
  2. Invite the same address again.
- Expected Result: The second invitation is rejected with a duplicate message (logged); the pending count does not increase twice.
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_008_invite_duplicate_blocked.py
- Notes: Walkthrough 8.4: duplicate invite surfaced inline.

### TC-GRP-009 - Create Group is blocked when the name is empty
- Priority: High
- Type: Negative
- Preconditions: Group form open.
- Test Data: empty and spaces-only name
- Steps:
  1. Leave the name empty, try to save.
  2. Type spaces only, try to save.
- Expected Result: No group is created; the form stays open; Save is disabled or an inline error is shown (logged).
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_009_create_group_empty_name.py
- Notes: Walkthrough 8.2: inline validation with specific toast feedback.

### TC-GRP-010 - A duplicate group name is rejected
- Priority: Medium
- Type: Negative
- Preconditions: A group named `QA Group <ts>` already exists (the scenario creates it first).
- Test Data: same name twice
- Steps:
  1. Create a group.
  2. Open the form again and use the exact same name; save.
- Expected Result: The second creation is rejected with a message about the duplicate name (logged).
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_010_create_group_duplicate_name.py
- Notes: Walkthrough 8.2: duplicate names give specific toast feedback.

### TC-GRP-011 - Group description is limited to 200 characters with a live counter
- Priority: Medium
- Type: Edge
- Preconditions: Group form open.
- Test Data: a 230-character text
- Steps:
  1. Type 230 characters into Description.
- Expected Result: Only 200 characters are accepted and the live counter shows 200 / 200.
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_011_group_description_limit.py
- Notes: Walkthrough 8.2: 200-character limit with live counter.

### TC-GRP-012 - Bulk upload of a valid file goes through Bulk Preview and imports the members
- Priority: High
- Type: Positive
- Preconditions: Group Details open; a valid CSV generated by the runner is on the device (adb push).
- Test Data: members_valid.csv: First Name, Last Name, Email, Mobile (3 rows)
- Steps:
  1. Open add member -> Upload.
  2. Choose the CSV in the device file picker.
  3. Review the Bulk Preview.
  4. Confirm the import.
- Expected Result: Bulk Preview lists the 3 parsed rows; after Confirm the members/invitations are added; success feedback is shown (logged).
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_012_bulk_upload_valid_file.py
- Notes: FSD Anchor 4.1/4.2, Walkthrough 8.4-8.5. The file-picker navigation is discovered by the runner. The exact template columns are not documented: if the app rejects the columns the failure message says so (download-template check is part of the scenario).

### TC-GRP-013 - Bulk upload flags invalid rows with validation errors
- Priority: Medium
- Type: Negative
- Preconditions: As GRP-012, with a CSV containing invalid rows.
- Test Data: members_invalid.csv: 1 valid row, 1 bad email, 1 missing name
- Steps:
  1. Upload the file.
  2. Review the preview / result.
- Expected Result: Invalid rows are reported with validation errors (logged); valid rows can still be processed; nothing invalid is imported silently.
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_013_bulk_upload_invalid_rows.py
- Notes: Release 1.3 section 5: validate, process valid records, display errors for invalid ones.

- Priority: Medium

- Test Data: last registered test user (e.g. member code AN1)
- Steps:
  1. Tap the member count.
  2. Read the members list.
- Expected Result: The list opens; the Anchor appears with their name and member code.
- Automation script path: source/mobile/alumnye/specs/groups/GRP_014_cohort_members_list.py
